title: Virtual Zoo
requirements: `Animal` hierarchy at least 3 levels deep (`Animal → Bird → Penguin`)
Virtual `speak()`, `move()`, `eat(Food)` with different behaviors; penguins override `move()` to swim
Interfaces `ISwimmer`, `IFlyer` mixed in with multiple inheritance
Feeding time simulation: random events per animal each "hour"
Virtual destructors with prints — prove every animal is cleaned up
